Business Definition: Writer contribution at writer grain.
Aggregation Guidance: Expected 100%; deviations indicate possible setup issues.

Business Definition: Royalty allocation share.
Formula / Rule: SUM(client_share_pc) by song + payment option + office group
Aggregation Guidance: Must not exceed 100%; need not equal 100%.

Business Definition: Count of active alerts.
Aggregation Guidance: Use distinct alert ID due to attachment joins.

Business Definition: Accounting-period closing balance.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum only at documented grain.

Business Definition: Amount payable to the Client/Payee for the statement period.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum only at statement grain.

Business Definition: Reserve amount tracked in capitalized accounting.
Aggregation Guidance: Definition details remain open.

Business Definition: Closing capitalized financial position.
Aggregation Guidance: Definition details remain open.

Business Definition: Gross amount reported by the paying source.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum at Statement Line grain.

Business Definition: Source royalty amount converted for processing.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum at Statement Line grain.

Business Definition: Song Share percentage multiplied by Contract Collectable percentage.
Aggregation Guidance: Do not sum percentages.

Business Definition: Converted net amount allocated to a Client interest.
Aggregation Guidance: Exclude Rate Type 4 as additional revenue.

Business Definition: Royalty amount payable to the Client.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum at Earnings Line grain.

Business Definition: NPS retained by processing office.
Aggregation Guidance: Do not count Participant rows independently.

Business Definition: NPS retained by foreign processing affiliate.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum at Earnings Line grain.

Business Definition: Amount posted to GL.
Formula / Rule: Royalty Payable + NPS; zero for Rate Type 4
Aggregation Guidance: Sum at Earnings Line grain.

Business Definition: Full-percent negotiated Sync License fee.
Aggregation Guidance: Aggregate after grain confirmation.

Business Definition: SMP gross share of Sync License fee.
Aggregation Guidance: Aggregate after grain confirmation.

Business Definition: Share of returned Writers with IPI.
Aggregation Guidance: Distinct Writer grain.

Business Definition: Share of current Publishers with CAE/IPI.
Aggregation Guidance: Distinct Publisher grain.

Business Definition: Number of radio detections for matched chart songs.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum by non-overlapping chart song, country, upload, and quarter.

Business Definition: Estimated audience associated with radio chart detections.
Aggregation Guidance: Do not add across overlapping markets/stations without source methodology.

Business Definition: Current ordinal position of the song on a named chart.
Aggregation Guidance: Ordinal, not additive; compare over time within the same chart.

Business Definition: Current-week on-demand streams for the chart song.
Aggregation Guidance: Aggregate only across non-overlapping songs, charts, territories, and weeks.

Business Definition: Current-week digital sales for the chart song.
Aggregation Guidance: YTD snapshots must not be summed across weeks.

Business Definition: Current-period album sales.
Aggregation Guidance: Period definitions and overlap with physical/digital components require SME validation.

Business Definition: Streams by provider, service tier, calculation model, and week.
Aggregation Guidance: Aggregate only when provider/tier/model dimensions do not overlap.

Business Definition: Share of chart-song records confirmed as matches.
Aggregation Guidance: Define eligible population, indicator values, and active-record scope before certification.

Business Definition: Count of Mechanical Products maintained within Tempo.
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct mechanical_product_id.

Business Definition: Count of Mechanical Products with a populated mechanical license number.
Formula / Rule: COUNT(DISTINCT mechanical_product_id) WHERE license_num IS NOT NULL
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct mechanical_product_id where license_num is populated. Confirm whether a populated License Number is sufficient to classify a product as licensed.

Business Definition: Product units sold reported at Mechanical Product grain.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum units_sold_qt only after confirming whether values represent period activity or cumulative snapshots. Do not sum repeated snapshots for the same product.

Business Definition: Total advance amount recorded for Mechanical Products.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum advance_am within currency_cd. Never aggregate mixed currencies; do not combine product-level and product-song advances until overlap and allocation rules are confirmed.

Business Definition: Estimated amount expected to be collectable from Mechanical Product licensing activity.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum total_est_collect_am within currency_cd. Calculation inputs and gross/net treatment require SME validation.

Business Definition: Average stored controlled percentage across Mechanical Products.
Aggregation Guidance: Average total_controlled_pc at product grain. Do not sum percentages. Consider a weighted average only after the approved weighting basis is confirmed.

Business Definition: Average stored collectable percentage across Mechanical Products.
Aggregation Guidance: Average total_collectable_pc at product grain. Do not sum percentages. Confirm null and zero treatment.

Business Definition: License-to-Date units sold reported across Mechanical Products.
Aggregation Guidance: Use the latest ltd_units_sold_dt per mechanical_product_id before summing ltd_units_sold_qt. LTD means License to Date, not Life to Date.

Business Definition: Count of Mechanical Products for which income has been matched.
Formula / Rule: COUNT(DISTINCT mechanical_product_id) WHERE income_matched indicates positive match
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct mechanical_product_id where income_matched represents a positive match. Allowed values and positive-state logic require validation.

Business Definition: Distribution of Mechanical Products by governed License Type.
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct mechanical_product_id grouped by license_type_id and license_type_nm. Reuse the governed SA-006 License Type domain.

Business Definition: Count of current Mechanical Product Song rows exposed by the view.
Aggregation Guidance: Count rows. Do not count distinct mechanical_product_song_id because it is populated but not unique. The view represents current source rows where prior_version_ind = 'N'.

Business Definition: Count of distinct current Tempo Songs represented in Mechanical Licensing.
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct song_id plus song_sequence_id. This counts songs, not product-song occurrences.

Business Definition: Average controlled percentage across Mechanical Product Song records.
Aggregation Guidance: Average controlled_pc at the documented child grain. Do not sum percentages; composite row grain and weighting rules remain open.

Business Definition: Average collectable percentage across Mechanical Product Song records.
Aggregation Guidance: Average collectable_pc at the documented child grain. Do not sum percentages; confirm null, zero, and weighting rules.

Business Definition: Total advances recorded on Mechanical Product Song records.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum advance_am within currency_cd and compatible licensing context. Do not combine with product-level advances until overlap and allocation rules are confirmed.

Business Definition: Aggregate controlled-rate amount represented by product-song licensing records.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum controlled_rate_am only within common currency_cd and licensing_rate_type_id. Confirm whether the amount is additive across product-song occurrences.

Business Definition: Aggregate collectable-rate amount represented by product-song licensing records.
Aggregation Guidance: Sum collectable_rate_am only within common currency_cd and licensing_rate_type_id. Confirm calculation and additivity before certification.

Business Definition: Count of product-song records whose income is indicated as matched to the parent Mechanical Product.
Formula / Rule: COUNT(*) WHERE income_matched_to_product indicates positive match
Aggregation Guidance: Count rows where income_matched_to_product represents a positive match. Allowed values and matching grain require validation.

Measure Name: Product-Song Records Matched to Statement Lines
Business Definition: Count of product-song records indicated as matched to royalty Statement Lines.
Formula / Rule: COUNT(*) WHERE matched_to_sl indicates positive match
Aggregation Guidance: Count rows where matched_to_sl represents a positive match. Validate the abbreviation, allowed values, and whether one record can match multiple Statement Lines.

Measure Name: Product-Song Records by Licensing Rate Type
Business Definition: Distribution of product-song records by licensing-rate methodology.
Aggregation Guidance: Count rows grouped by licensing_rate_type_id and licensing_rate_type_nm. Domain values and rate behavior require validation.

Business Definition: Number of Mechanical Products entering the license-request workflow.
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct mechanical_product_id grouped by request_dt. Exact request event requires confirmation.

Business Definition: Number of Mechanical Products with a recorded license issuance date.
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct mechanical_product_id grouped by issued_dt.

Business Definition: Average elapsed calendar days from license request to license issuance.
Aggregation Guidance: Average DATEDIFF(day, request_dt, issued_dt) for records where both dates are populated and issued_dt is not before request_dt. Confirm calendar-day versus business-day convention.

Business Definition: Count of products with an expected first-income date but without a confirmed income match.
Formula / Rule: COUNT(DISTINCT mechanical_product_id) WHERE first_income_expected_dt IS NOT NULL AND income_matched is not positive
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct mechanical_product_id where first_income_expected_dt is populated and income_matched is not a positive match. Match values and overdue treatment require validation.

Business Definition: Distribution of Mechanical Products by responsible originating office.
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct mechanical_product_id grouped by orig_office_id and orig_office_nm. Preserve null lookups because office enrichment is a LEFT JOIN.

Business Definition: Distribution of Mechanical Products by Licensee.
Aggregation Guidance: Count distinct mechanical_product_id grouped by licensee_id and licensee_nm. Preserve null lookups because Licensee enrichment is a LEFT JOIN.

Business Definition: Total GL-posted amount for the summarized population.
Aggregation Guidance: Additive only within the same currency and without double-counting grouped dimensions.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Total amount payable to Clients.
Aggregation Guidance: Additive within currency; this view is Client-perspective.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Final NPS earned by Client Originating Offices.
Aggregation Guidance: Additive within currency; excludes processing-office-retained NPS and is not total SMP NPS.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Royalty amounts analyzed across Mech, Perf, Sync, and Other.
Formula / Rule: Group selected monetary measure by income_group and currency_cd.
Aggregation Guidance: Choose detailed income_type_group_nm where the question needs more granularity.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Royalty amounts whose detailed Income Type is flagged Streaming.
Formula / Rule: SUM(selected amount) WHERE is_streaming_ind=TRUE, grouped by currency_cd.
Aggregation Guidance: Do not infer streaming only from high-level Income Group.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Royalty amounts separated by on-hold status.
Formula / Rule: Group selected monetary measure by on_hold_ind and currency_cd.
Aggregation Guidance: Do not combine held and non-held populations unless intentionally reporting total exposure.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Royalty Processed Amount
Aggregation Guidance: Additive within currency.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Royalty Expense Amount
Aggregation Guidance: Additive within currency.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Client Office NPS
Aggregation Guidance: Excludes processing-office-retained NPS.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Statement-Level Earnings Reconciliation
Aggregation Guidance: Expected exactly zero at common grain.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: Distinct Statement Headers
Aggregation Guidance: Requires hidden Processing Office context; statement_header_id alone is unsafe.
Notes: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency.

Business Definition: The calculated gross royalty income attributed to a Client after the incoming royalty transaction has matched to a Song and completed the royalty-calculation process, but before withholding-tax and NPS calculations are applied.
Formula / Rule: SUM(client_financials_v.gross_client_income_am) for the selected reporting population. The view source already contains post-calculation summarized amounts and is restricted to affiliate_income_ind = 'N'.
Aggregation Guidance: Additive across calculated royalty receipts only when currency_cd is the same. Group by Statement Period and any dimensions required by the analysis. Do not sum across Client Originating Office currencies without an approved conversion method.
Notes: Post-calculation, pre-withholding-tax and pre-NPS amount. It is not the raw amount from the incoming statement line. Supports analysis of calculated earnings before downstream tax and NPS treatments.

Business Definition: A Client Financials monetary measure displayed by Tempo and sourced from the post-calculation Earnings Line Summarization layer. The definitive enterprise interpretation has not yet been confirmed.
Formula / Rule: SUM(client_financials_v.client_local_income_am) for the selected reporting population. No relationship to Gross Client Income, Client Net Income, withholding tax, NPS, or Royalty Payable should be inferred until validation is complete.
Aggregation Guidance: Provisionally additive within a single currency for UI reproduction only. Include currency_cd. Do not use as a certified enterprise KPI or derive ratios from it until PV-SEL-031 is resolved.
Notes: Open validation PV-SEL-031. Users may reproduce the value shown in Tempo but should not infer its calculation or financial meaning.

Business Definition: A downstream Client income amount calculated by Tempo and displayed in Client Financials. The deductions and adjustments included in the value have not yet been formally confirmed.
Formula / Rule: SUM(client_financials_v.client_net_income_am) for the selected reporting population. Do not assume the measure equals Gross Client Income less withholding tax, NPS, or any other combination of fields.
Aggregation Guidance: Provisionally additive within a single currency for UI reproduction only. Include currency_cd. Do not certify or use as the basis for enterprise KPIs until PV-SEL-032 is resolved.
Notes: Open validation PV-SEL-032. The amount may be used to reconcile to Tempo, but its precise business calculation remains unvalidated.

Business Definition: The royalty amount payable to the Client for the calculated royalty receipt, interpreted from the Client perspective within this view.
Formula / Rule: SUM(client_financials_v.royalty_payable_am) for the selected Statement Period and reporting dimensions, using affiliate_income_ind = 'N'.
Aggregation Guidance: Additive within a common currency. Include currency_cd in totals. Aggregate at Statement Period or higher only after retaining any Client, Song, Contract, Source, Income Type, Rate Type, and Transaction Type distinctions required by the business question.
Notes: Supports Client payment review, royalty-statement reconciliation, and payable analysis. Do not assume equality with Gross, Local, or Net Client Income without a separately validated relationship.

Business Definition: The actual withholding tax deducted from the Client's royalty earnings based on where the Client is based and which SMP affiliate collected or processed the royalty.
Aggregation Guidance: Additive within a common currency. Include currency_cd and retain relevant Client, collecting-affiliate, Statement Period, and Source context when explaining tax outcomes.
Notes: This is a realized tax deduction, not an estimate or accrual. It supports tax reconciliation, Client payment explanation, and review of jurisdiction- or affiliate-driven withholding differences.

Business Definition: The final NPS earned by the Client Originating Office for the calculated royalty receipt after intercompany processing and affiliate retention have been applied.
Formula / Rule: SUM(client_financials_v.nps_am) for the selected reporting population.
Aggregation Guidance: Additive within a common currency. Include currency_cd. Analyze separately from Foreign NPS unless the objective explicitly requires both Client-office-earned and affiliate-retained NPS components.
Notes: Does not represent total NPS earned by SMP. NPS retained by a collecting or processing affiliate is excluded and reported separately as Foreign NPS.

Business Definition: NPS retained by a collecting or processing affiliate before intercompany remittance to the Client Originating Office.
Formula / Rule: SUM(client_financials_v.foreign_nps_am) for the selected reporting population.
Aggregation Guidance: Additive within a common currency. Include currency_cd. Keep separate from Client Office NPS for normal Client-perspective reporting; combine only when the stated analysis requires a broader view of NPS across the processing chain.
Notes: Represents an affiliate-retained component rather than NPS earned by the Client Originating Office. Useful for explaining NPS allocation across collecting, processing, and Client offices.

Business Definition: A control KPI confirming that financial measures returned by client_financials_v reproduce the corresponding values displayed in the Tempo Client module Financial tab for equivalent selections.
Formula / Rule: For each validated monetary measure: SUM(View Amount) - Tempo UI Amount. Expected result = 0 when equivalent Client, Statement Period, Song, Source hierarchy, Contract, Income Type, Rate Type, Transaction Type, and currency filters are applied.
Aggregation Guidance: Reconcile each measure independently and within currency_cd. Use Statement Period, not Accounting Period. Restrict the source population to affiliate_income_ind = 'N'. Investigate filter alignment, summarization completion, and displayed detail when the variance is non-zero.
Source Object: dp_summarised_el.client_financials_v and Tempo Client Financials UI
Notes: Primary operational-quality control for the object. Including both affiliate indicator values doubles expected amounts and invalidates reconciliation.

Business Definition: The number of calculated Client royalty receipt rows displayed at the validated Client Financials grain for the selected Statement Period and filters.
Formula / Rule: COUNT(*) from client_financials_v after applying the approved reporting filters. Each row represents a calculated Client royalty receipt with Song-level and maximum available Source/Sub Source detail.
Aggregation Guidance: The count is sensitive to the detailed grouping dimensions and should not be interpreted as a distinct count of Clients, Songs, Contracts, or incoming statement lines. Use affiliate_income_ind = 'N' and state all filters used.
Notes: Supports volume analysis and UI row-count reconciliation. Aggregating or hiding dimensions can combine amounts but does not change the underlying receipt-row count.

Business Definition: Quarter-end factor converting Originating Office currency to USD.
Formula / Rule: Select the rate matching Statement Period and Originating Office.
Aggregation Guidance: Non-additive; never sum rates.

Business Definition: Month-end closing factor converting local currency to USD.
Formula / Rule: Select the rate matching month-end period and currency.
Aggregation Guidance: Non-additive; never sum rates.
Notes: Management Reporting and Month-End Close; no Tempo use.

Business Definition: Count of expected Statement Period / Office combinations with a positive rate.
Formula / Rule: Count valid unique combinations against expected offices.
Aggregation Guidance: Count by Statement Period.

Business Definition: Count of expected Month-End / Currency combinations with a positive rate.
Formula / Rule: Count valid unique combinations against required reporting currencies.
Aggregation Guidance: Count by month-end period.
